title: S10 instrumentation report
description: architecture.md S10, report-only mode only in this phase: for each DTO of a supported change.type, either a proposed diff (never written to the target repo) or a stated refusal reason. fix mode (real edits/commits) is not represented by this schema yet -- when it lands, mode's enum grows and an applied-and-committed status is added, not silently redefined.

results.description: One entry per DTO in the input implementation_dto.json, in the same order. Empty array is valid (no DTOs given).

status.description: applied: agent produced a diff (not written). refused: agent checked preconditions/anchor against the real file and declined, with a reason -- SP4's dto-003 case, a correct outcome, not a bug. unsupported: change.type isn't one of the 4 this phase covers -- never attempted, not a silent skip. failed: the agent session itself errored (SDK/transport failure, malformed response) -- distinct from a considered refusal.

diff.description: Proposed unified diff, present only when status is 'applied'. Never written to the target repo in this mode.

reason.description: Required context for refused/unsupported/failed; null for applied.

syntax_valid.description: ast.parse() sanity check on the proposed patched file content, present only when status is 'applied'. Informational only -- report-only never commits regardless of this value; SP4 found py_compile-equivalent checks insufficient for semantic bugs, so this is a cheap signal, not a verification gate.
